name: membrane
description: Static-analysis security audit for agent project configs, enabled plugins, hooks, MCP, and secrets.

interface.shortDescription: Audit agent project configs and enabled plugins.
interface.longDescription: Membrane scans agent project configuration, enabled plugins, hooks, MCP settings, agent and command prompts, and secrets, over a closed input: a symlink, a file that is not regular, a name outside printable ASCII or a file over 1 MiB is one stop that names it. The Codex build adds Codex-specific config targets while preserving Claude Code checks.
defaultPrompt: Run a security audit for this agent project.
Scan this project for leaked credentials.
Review the hooks this project and its plugins run.
